offers_products.reason: Makes LaCroix sparkling water, Rip It energy drinks, Everfresh juices, Shasta and Faygo sodas.

offers_services.reason: Sells only packaged beverages; no work done for customers as a main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer beverage brands like LaCroix and Shasta, chosen by shoppers in stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Retailers and grocers buy its beverages for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of drinks from retailers and repeat purchases by shoppers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-priced everyday beverages; demand holds up in downturns, with some trading down.

big_ticket.reason: Cans and bottles of drinks are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured beverage brands and products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Consumer brands sold to shoppers through stores; the end buyers are households.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs its own bottling and canning plants and a distribution network.

notes: Large retail chains are major direct buyers, so the large-customers answer is debatable.
